about: Split calls from the fix-after campaign, batch fix-18 (2026-10-11): split listings whose areas were wrong or overlapped, each read off the aerial photo.

listings.note: The middle loops (096 to 177) are one place; at the default gap they were cut down the middle into two overlapping areas, so a gap of 100 m keeps them whole and puts the hike-in sites HI05 to HI20 in the forest to the east in their own areas.
